record.label: Forest Fire / Prevention Officer — tree shield
record.limitations: Clean designed reconstruction of the photographed badge. Smooth geometry and outlined type replace all image-derived contours. Relief, hammered grain, ageing, reflections and display stands are omitted. Exact original typeface, die engraving and material tones cannot be authenticated; the few silver/bronze fills are a material interpretation. The historical pine, roots and optional mountains/water are hand-drawn geometric symbols fitted to the specimen, rather than substitutes for the modern ministry emblem.
